Application Security

リプレイ攻撃検出

A security mechanism to identify and block attempts where valid data transmissions are maliciously repeated or delayed, often to gain unauthorized access or privileges.

Definition

A security mechanism to identify and block attempts where valid data transmissions are maliciously repeated or delayed, often to gain unauthorized access or privileges.

Operational example

SOC alert: Replay attack detection flagged identical authentication requests from the same source, suggesting an attempt to reuse valid session tokens.
